_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for which Pi model and thinking level each proposal-framework subagent runs on. Read by scripts/gen-pi.py to write BOTH the `model:`/`thinking:` frontmatter of .pi/agents/*.md and the runtime profile store .pi/subagents.json, so the declared fallback and the effective profile can never disagree. Reconciled and confirmed by /propuesta-init at session start.
_meta.why_tiers_and_not_models: The canonical Claude source (.claude/agents/*.md) names a Claude tier (`sonnet`/`opus`) because Claude Code is its native runtime. The Pi port must not inherit that name: `claude-bridge/*` is a bridge to the Claude Agent SDK, i.e. an external Claude dependency. The port therefore maps each AGENT to a concrete Pi model from this file, and this file is reconciled against the operator's active gentle profile instead of guessing from the Claude tier.
_meta.vendor_policy: No `claude-bridge/` model may be written into .pi/ unless `allow_claude_bridge` is set to true below, which requires a deliberate, reviewable edit. The default for this framework is Pi-native models only.

reconciled_against._note: /propuesta-init re-runs this reconciliation at session start: it reads the ACTIVE gentle profile, checks every model id below against `pi --list-models`, shows the table to the operator and rewrites this block (and the tiers, if the operator changes them) only after confirmation.

reasoning.why: Long-form Spanish reasoning and argumentation: subproblem framing, narrative sections, budget arithmetic. Needs the strongest reasoning available in the active profile.

analysis.why: Reading-heavy work with bounded output: bibliographic synthesis, gate review, structured extraction. `medium` keeps the reasoning budget from consuming the provider's 32k output cap.

mechanical.why: Short, well-specified output: write a JSON spec, judge four visual criteria, repair a spec, audit prose cadence. `low` is deliberate: at `high` these agents burned the whole 32k output budget on reasoning and returned no report at all (measured: three consecutive disenador-tikz failures of 6-9 minutes each in run 2026-09-tept-depresion-ia-portable).

runtime._note: stall_timeout_ms is 10 min because a legitimately long delegated phase (bibliografo-propuesta scanning a 50-paper corpus) can be quiet for minutes without being stuck.
